name: Croploft
tagline: Run your indoor farm from seedling to sale without the clipboard chaos.
positioning: Croploft is the operations platform for small vertical farms — track every rack, forecast every harvest, and keep your whole crew on the same grow plan.

hero.h1: Every rack, every harvest, one calm dashboard.
hero.sub: Croploft helps owner-operators of vertical farms plan grow cycles, log climate and nutrients, and hit harvest dates — without juggling whiteboards, spreadsheets, and sticky notes on the tower doors.

features.title: Rack-by-rack grow plans
features.description: Map every tier and channel to a crop, seed date, and target harvest. Croploft schedules transplants and cuts so nothing sits a day too long.

features.title: Climate & nutrient logs
features.description: Record EC, pH, temp, and RH per zone in seconds. Spot the drift before a batch of basil bolts or tip-burns on you.

features.title: Harvest forecasting
features.description: See projected yield by week so you can promise your chef and CSA members exactly what you'll actually cut.

features.title: Food-safety records
features.description: Keep wash logs, lot codes, and traceability tidy and audit-ready — the paperwork a buyer asks for before they'll sign.

features.title: Order & delivery board
features.description: Turn standing restaurant and market orders into a pick list that matches what's coming off the racks this week.

features.title: Crew tasks
features.description: Assign seeding, transplanting, and harvest work to your team and see what's done from your phone on the packing table.

testimonials.quote: We were running four spreadsheets and a wall of dry-erase. Croploft put the whole grow schedule in one place, and we stopped losing trays to missed transplant dates.
testimonials.name: Marisol Trejo

testimonials.quote: The harvest forecast is what sold me. I can tell my chefs on Monday exactly how many cases of microgreens land Thursday, and I'm right almost every time now.
testimonials.name: Dev Anand

testimonials.quote: My food-safety audit used to eat a full weekend. This year I exported the wash and lot logs in ten minutes and passed clean.
testimonials.name: Karen Okafor

pricing.blurb: For the one-person farm running a single grow room.

homepage.footerBlurb: Croploft is built for the growers doing the seeding, harvesting, and selling themselves. Fewer clipboards, more clean cuts.
